title: Function Health hero
description: A full-window photo hero (window height minus the announcement strip) with a dark fade at the bottom: a glass pill, a huge light italic serif headline, a light line of copy and two pills bottom-left, and three headline figures with thin vertical dividers bottom-right (stacked in a row under the copy on phones). The copy rises in on load.
notes: the media slot takes a photo or video; the empty placeholder is dark so the light text reads
text uses the page colour over a foreground-coloured backdrop, so it flips with the mode
leaves room at the top for the floating header, which sits over this block
